title: Change address and contact details on a qualified supervisor certificate
summary: If you hold a qualified supervisor certificate, you can update your address or contact details online if Building Commission NSW has your email or mobile number on record.
intro:
If you hold a qualified supervisor certificate and Building Commission NSW has your email address or mobile phone number on record you can update your address or contact details online.

To check your qualified supervisor certificate number and details visit Verify NSW.

Only your address and contact details can be changed online.

### Change of name

If you want to change your name on your certificate you need to visit a service centre with a copy of the name change document such as a marriage certificate. Find out more about change of name.
who_can_apply: Building Commission NSW must have your email address or mobile phone number on record

how_to_steps.text: Follow the prompts to update your details.
Download and complete the Change of address/contact details – PDF.
To submit the form send it to the email address on the form or go to a service centre.

faqs.q: How can I check my qualified supervisor certificate number and details?
faqs.a: You can visit Verify NSW to check your qualified supervisor certificate number and details.

faqs.q: What details can I change online?
faqs.a: You can only change your address and contact details online.

faqs.q: How do I change my name on my certificate?
faqs.a: To change your name, you must visit a service centre with a copy of the name change document, such as a marriage certificate.
